name: Saint Martin (French part)

findings.summary: A State (DEAL Guadeloupe) project annex maps the CELIA subsea cable route through Saint-Martin's contiguous zone to a landing site, with June 2025 bathymetric surveys. Orange's CELIA trunk, supplied by ASN, targets service in Q3 2027.
findings.analyst_inference: Only the DEAL annex places CELIA at Saint-Martin; Orange and DCD name ASN as supplier but list only Martinique, Aruba, Antigua, Puerto Rico and Florida, so applying ASN to the Saint-Martin segment is inference. Annex is undated apart from June 2025 surveys. French vendor coded third, consistent with BLM-001. Tier 2: survey/permit-dossier stage.

findings.summary: Orange announced the commercial launch of its 5G network in Saint-Martin from 11 August 2023, starting in Marigot.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: spec sets network pole by equipment vendor, which the source does not name. Tier 5 as a commercial launch, though initial coverage was limited to Marigot. No Huawei/ZTE mention found. Single opened S3 source.

findings.controller: Not stated (camera/VMS vendor and integrator unnamed)
findings.financier: French State FIPD (applied for; grant not confirmed)
findings.summary: The Collectivité plans 80 video-protection cameras in two phases (2026-2028), estimated at EUR 4m; prefectoral authorisation obtained and fibre groundwork begun, with the supervision centre to be rebuilt. No AI or vendor mentioned.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null because the equipment vendor is not named; no AI analytics or facial recognition reported, so relevance to the AI stack depends on the vendor. Tier 4 as authorisation obtained and works started. EUR 4m not converted. Single opened S3 source.

facilities.null_reason: one search found no data-centre or AI-campus project in French Saint-Martin; results were mainland France only

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchase or export-licence item surfaced in other searches

models.null_reason: one search found only a November 2025 CNFPT AI training session for Collectivité staff naming no provider, tool or contract
